title: "Episode 002: Nurgle Marked Warriors of Chaos"
subtitle: "Getting back into Warhammer Fantasy"
# toc: true
---

Without a doubt my favourite miniatures I've worked on, both for nostalgia and the paintjob I accomplished, are the Warhammer Fantasy 6th edition Chaos Knights. I painted a unit of five of these late in 2024 and I think they are just superb - everything I ever wanted out of Warhammer when I was a kid just getting into the hobby without much money. They form the core of my growing Warhammer fantasy chaos army


One of the first things I did on setting up my hobby desk in Luxembourg was pull out my Nurgle Chaos Warriors.I got these (definitely genuine and not recast) metal miniatures as part of a lot from a trader.
